dialogues.speaker: Kovanskaya
dialogues.text: ...Are you sure that person isn't dangerous? Traveling alone like that is pretty risky.

dialogues.speaker: Krushina
dialogues.text: Snezhnaya isn't that dangerous, you know. Besides, we've been pen pals for a long, long time, and we've met several times already. He's truly a very, very good person.

dialogues.speaker: Kovanskaya
dialogues.text: But... just because of a few letters, you're taking a long train ride to meet a stranger at a midway station... That still sounds really dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Krushina
dialogues.text: Hey, I told you, he's not a stranger! He's a good friend!

dialogues.speaker: Krushina
dialogues.text: Besides, aren't you traveling alone too? Why aren't you worried about danger now?

dialogues.speaker: Kovanskaya
dialogues.text: I... I'm scared too! But I still need to go... My mother is very ill, so I'm going to the place she used to live to get some local specialties for her...

dialogues.speaker: Kovanskaya
dialogues.text: That way... maybe she'll feel a little better...

dialogues.speaker: Krushina
dialogues.text: Ah... I'm sorry, I didn't know...

dialogues.speaker: Krushina
dialogues.text: You're really brave. More brave than I am. Your mother will definitely get better!
